Episode Notes:
Stephanie Carvin joins Daisy Johnston to unpack the escalating tariff war between Canada and the United States, sparked by U.S. President Donald Trump’s 50% tariffs on Canadian imports. They explore how the partnership headed into economic conflict and what it will take for Canada and the United States to find their way back.
